extDescription.message: Coffre’s local companion: fills logins from the unlocked app, with no server or telemetry.

options_subtitle.message: Local autofill, with no server or telemetry.

options_appAddressCopy.message: The extension queries the unlocked Coffre tab to retrieve the current site’s logins. It stores no secret.

options_how1.message: Open Coffre and unlock your vault.

options_how2.message: On a site, click the Coffre icon in the toolbar.

options_how3.message: Choose “Fill”: the fields are completed in the active page.

options_privacy.message: The master password and keys never leave the Coffre tab. Logins only travel in memory between that tab and the active page. Close or lock the Coffre tab to cut access.

options_permissionsCopy.message: The extension requests access to the active tab when filling, and to the Coffre address configured above. It has no access to other tabs outside your action.

passkey_warning.message: Only approve if you initiated this request. The private key remains encrypted in your vault.

error_locked.message: Coffre is locked. Unlock it in its tab.

error_needsPairing.message: Pair this extension with Coffre before continuing.

error_pairProtocol.message: Pairing was interrupted. Try again from Coffre.

error_domainMismatch.message: This login is not saved for this site.

error_permission.message: Allow the extension to access the Coffre tab in the settings.

error_noFields.message: No login field detected on this page.

error_noTab.message: This page does not allow autofill.

error_notFound.message: This login no longer exists in the vault.

error_nativeTimeout.message: Coffre is not responding. Check that the app is open.

error_nativeUnavailable.message: The Coffre desktop app is unavailable.
